findings.title: Expired lease on an old frame regresses its state to incomplete after rework verify
findings.evidence: Lease 1 on origin frame 1 (run 3) was created 16:59:58, expired 17:14:58 and was never closed because the reviewer did not call frames/complete (harness skipped that step). Rework verify then set the frame to awaiting_followup. At 17:25:16 the reviewer claimed run 7: review.services._close_expired materialised the expired lease and set frame 1 to INCOMPLETE (previous_reviewer=reviewer, incomplete_since=17:14:58). Frame 1 was then never completed by complete_scope_frames (it only completes awaiting_followup).
findings.impact: If a reviewer leaves the frame without 'complete' (closed browser) and rework is verified later, the frame is pushed back to incomplete and the scope frames cannot complete automatically; resume would require the reviewer to claim it again.
findings.scope: lease/expiry (#238 / T-033), not #243. Not fixed; no code changed.
findings.options: (a) _close_expired should not overwrite states other than in_review/unreviewed; (b) complete_scope_frames should also complete frames left incomplete once all issues are closed; (c) accept and document: reviewer must complete frames before requesting rework. Decision belongs to the coordinator/PO.

findings.title: Annotator/FE has no way to learn the current CVAT revision needed for POST /api/rework/{id}/submitted/
findings.evidence: cvat_revision must equal revision_sha256 of the snapshot LabelX builds at submit time; I had to precompute it with a separate snapshot (harness method)
